'''Victor''' (Japanese: '''ビクター''' ''Victor'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG153|Tactics Theatrics!!]]'' as the assistant to [[Tucker]] at the [[Battle Dome]]. He [[Battle judge|refereed]] the battle between Tucker and Ash from a mobile hovering platform.

After Ash won the battle, Victor declared him the winner and Ash found the [[Symbol|Tactics Symbol]] in his {{AP|hat}}.
